quantum_weights_1_to_9.description: Абсолютный запрет пыток (UNCAT Art. 2.2). Квантовая суперпозиция исключает любые оправдания.

weight_1.principle: No exceptional circumstances whatsoever (war, political instability) may be invoked.

weight_2.principle: An order from a superior officer or a public authority may not be invoked as a justification.

weight_4.principle: Criminalization of torture in domestic law (Art. 4)

weight_9.principle: Inadmissibility of evidence obtained under torture (Art. 15)

imperative_layer_10_plus.description: Механизмы исполнения и восстановления (Jus Cogens nullifier)

norms.norm: Prompt and impartial investigation wherever there is reasonable ground to believe an act of torture has been committed.
Right to complain to, and to have the case promptly and impartially examined by, competent authorities with whistleblower protection.
Enforceable right to fair and adequate compensation, including the means for as full rehabilitation as possible.
